services.desc: If you are born after September 1st of 1993, you are required to have boater education training in order to operate the jet ski/ jet car alone. If you are born after that date, DON'T WORRY! You can still drive. One of our deckhands will just have to accompany you while you are operating the jet ski or jet car. If you have someone in your party who is born before September 1st, 1993 they can also accompany you instead! Unfortunately, we did not make the rules, but we do have to follow them. Fortunately, there is a workaround that will allow you to still enjoy your experience!
